page_title: FRA 4-1 AUS | France v Australia 22/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Half-chance! Aziz Behich (Australia) plays a pass into the box, but Hugo Lloris reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+7' The foul by Kylian Mbappe (France) was seen by Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+5' Aaron Mooy (Australia) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (France) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 40875.
90+1' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ibrahima Konate (France) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
90' France have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Didier Deschamps has decided to substitute Olivier Giroud and he is replaced by Marcus Thuram (France).
89' Substitution. Benjamin Pavard leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jules Kounde (France).

88' Benjamin Pavard (France) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to France.
87' Kingsley Coman (France) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
85' Graham Arnold prepares a substitution. Nathaniel Atkinson is replaced by Milos Degenek (Australia).
85' Keanu Baccus (Australia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jackson Irvine.
85' 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
82' Kylian Mbappe (France) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
80' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes shows a yellow card to Jackson Irvine (Australia) for his blatant foul.
79' Aaron Mooy (Australia) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
79' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Olivier Giroud (France) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Australia.
77' Didier Deschamps has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kingsley Coman (France) replacing Ousmane Dembele.
77' Didier Deschamps has decided to make a change. Youssouf Fofana (France) replaces Aurelien Tchouameni.
73' Substitution. Garang Kuol has come on for Craig Goodwin (Australia).
73' That's the end of the game for Riley McGree, who is replaced by Awer Mabil (Australia).

71' 4 - 1 Kylian Mbappe showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Olivier Giroud (France) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 4:1.
71' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle after Jackson Irvine (Australia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

68' 3 - 1 Ousmane Dembele sends a superb cross into the box. Kylian Mbappe (France) latches on to it and from close range plants a header in off the bottom of the left post, leaving Mathew Ryan beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:1.
68' Antoine Griezmann (France) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.

64' Kylian Mbappe (France) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
64' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows the whistle, Riley McGree (Australia) is penalised for a foul.
63' Ibrahima Konate (France) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
63' The referee awards a corner and Antoine Griezmann (France) goes over to take it.
63' Kylian Mbappe (France) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
61' Kylian Mbappe (France) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

61' Kylian Mbappe (France) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Kylian Mbappe (France) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. France force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' A cross by Antoine Griezmann (France) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
59' The France players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
58' Ousmane Dembele (France) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
56' Substitution. Jason Cummings (Australia) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mitchell Duke walks off.
55' Mitchell Duke (Australia) has tested the patience of referee Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Kylian Mbappe (France) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
53' Kylian Mbappe (France) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
53' Jackson Irvine (Australia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. France get a free kick.
52' Kylian Mbappe (France) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
51' Riley McGree (Australia) brings an opponent down and Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes interrupts the game. A free kick to France.
50' Olivier Giroud (France) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Theo Hernandez, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the left post.
50' This shall not pass! Aurelien Tchouameni (France) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
49' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Craig Goodwin (Australia).
48' The corner from Craig Goodwin (Australia) is cleared away by the defence.
47' Nathaniel Atkinson (Australia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Australia will have a chance to score from a corner.
47' Jackson Irvine (Australia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Mitchell Duke (Australia) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' France seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+4' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:0.
45+2' Jackson Irvine (Australia) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (France) gets on the end of a cross from Antoine Griezmann, but his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' France are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
42' Kylian Mbappe links up with Antoine Griezmann (France), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
42' Ousmane Dembele (France) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

40' Mathew Ryan doesn't have to worry about this one. Kylian Mbappe plays a pass into the feet of Ousmane Dembele (France), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
37' Olivier Giroud (France) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
36' Kylian Mbappe (France) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
34' France are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
32' 2 - 1 Olivier Giroud (France) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Adrien Rabiot, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
30' A decent cross gives Olivier Giroud (France) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
29' Antoine Griezmann (France) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

29' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee blows his whistle, France are awarded a corner kick.
27' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Theo Hernandez sends a long raking pass onto the head of Adrien Rabiot (France), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
27' Antoine Griezmann (France) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
26' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (France). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

26' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Antoine Griezmann (France) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The linesman makes the right call and France will have a corner.
25' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
24' Kylian Mbappe (France) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Riley McGree (Australia) commits a foul and Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes immediately signals a free kick.
22' Mitchell Duke (Australia) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
21' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Craig Goodwin (Australia).
19' Kylian Mbappe (France) and Ousmane Dembele attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Theo Hernandez (France).
18' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle for a foul after Adrien Rabiot (France) hacks down one of his opponents.
16' Theo Hernandez (France) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes signals.
15' Kylian Mbappe (France) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
13' Theo Hernandez (France) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
13' The corner from Kylian Mbappe (France) is intercepted by the defence.
13' Lucas Hernandez (France) is substituted due to injury. Didier Deschamps gives a chance to Theo Hernandez.

12' Kylian Mbappe (France) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. France are awarded a corner kick.
11' The injury to Lucas Hernandez (France) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Craig Goodwin (Australia) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Mathew Leckie, then sends the ball into the roof of the net. 0:1.
8' Wonderful movement by Australia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' Kylian Mbappe (France) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Riley McGree (Australia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
3' Riley McGree (Australia) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.

3' Adrien Rabiot (France) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' Ousmane Dembele (France) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
2' Kylian Mbappe (France) takes the corner which is cleared.
2' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. France will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
France will kick the game off.
Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
